subject.title: feat(cron): declarative jobs with owner attribution and richer status

question: Should OpenClaw accept declaration-keyed cron jobs as the durable routines direction and own the new cron protocol, CLI, generated-client, and SQLite contracts?
rationale: The patch replaces a separate routines registry with permanent cron API/storage semantics, which is a product and compatibility boundary rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept Cron-Native Direction
options.body: Require docs and real CLI/Gateway proof, then review this as the preferred replacement for the separate routines registry.

options.title: Narrow The Contract
options.body: Keep only the smallest approved declaration/status pieces and defer optional result, owner, or CLI surface until maintainers are ready to own it.

options.title: Return To Design Tracker
options.body: Pause this PR and keep the open routines issue as the product-design owner if cron-native declaration keys are not yet settled.

recommendation.title: Accept Cron-Native Direction
recommendation.body: Require docs and real CLI/Gateway proof, then review this as the preferred replacement for the separate routines registry.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the listed maintainer, authored the cron-native PR, and has the strongest cron/state history for this boundary.
